priorities.1: correctness or high-value measured performance work
priorities.2: targeted optimization, lifecycle or validation improvement

findings.title: Replace repeated free-ID sort/shift with min-heaps
findings.observation: 16,384-instance delete/refill median 1347.126 ms baseline vs 2.314875 ms heap prototype, 3 rounds.
findings.proposedChange: Minimum-ID heaps for both free collections; preserve smallest-ID reuse and capacity/copy behavior.
findings.acceptance: Randomized instance/geometry reuse, resize, copy, failed allocation and total delete+refill cost.
findings.developmentStatus: Source patterns remain at pinned dev; prototype runtime r187 only.

findings.title: Avoid uploads for invisible single materials
findings.observation: 128 dirty hidden meshes submit 1,179,648 buffer bytes/frame; early guard submits 0 with matching pixels and visible child preserved.
findings.proposedChange: Guard single-material visibility before objects.update; preserve traversal and grouped material semantics.
findings.acceptance: Reveal/deferred upload, visible descendants, instancing, sprites, groups, clipping and callbacks.
findings.developmentStatus: Source pattern remains; candidate Chrome WebGL only.

findings.title: Track sparse batch transform/color texture ranges
findings.observation: One matrix/color edit at capacity16384: texture bytes 1,310,720 ->80; including unchanged indirect cost total1,376,256 ->65,616.
findings.proposedChange: Dirty component ranges with full initial allocation, resize safeguards and dense threshold.
findings.acceptance: Initial storage, sparse/dense edits, clone/copy/grow/shrink, multiple renderers and contexts.
findings.developmentStatus: Source pattern remains; candidate r187 Chrome WebGL only.

findings.title: Do not upload unchanged indirect draw IDs
findings.observation: Static capacity4096 batch submits16,384 bytes/render; changed-only prototype submits0 until order changes.
findings.proposedChange: Compare produced IDs before setting indirectTexture.needsUpdate; keep count/cull work.
findings.acceptance: Reverse order, count-only, zero/reuse, shadow/main and multi-camera passes, both multi-draw paths.
findings.developmentStatus: Source pattern remains; WebGPU path needs separate design.

findings.title: Initialize replacement batch textures after resize
findings.observation: Clone/grow baseline blank; explicit texture invalidation restores20,937 colored pixels.
findings.proposedChange: Mark replacement copied matrix/color/indirect textures dirty.
findings.acceptance: Untouched growth/shrink, absent/present color, clone/copy and restored contexts.
findings.developmentStatus: Source pattern remains at pinned dev.

findings.title: Plan row-aware DataTexture ranges
findings.observation: 4x4 RGBA component range(0,32) generates width8,height1 and GL error1282.
findings.proposedChange: Split first/last partial rows and interior full-row rectangles; validate bounds/alignment and initialization.
findings.acceptance: Cross-row, overlapping/misaligned components, format/type/mipmap, allocation and contexts.
findings.developmentStatus: Source pattern remains at pinned dev; no patch supplied.

findings.title: Optional per-instance ray acceleration
findings.observation: One-hit rays still issue1024/16384 inner Mesh tests for those instance counts.
findings.proposedChange: Optional outer instance hierarchy with explicit refit/rebuild; retain small dynamic linear path.
findings.acceptance: Construction/refit memory and cost, all-hit order, IDs, bounds and dynamic transforms.
findings.developmentStatus: Release behavior measured; acceleration proposal not benchmarked.

findings.title: Coalesce WebGL uniform-buffer writes
findings.observation: 256 changed vec4 uniforms generate256 writes for4096bytes; unchanged group generates0.
findings.proposedChange: Packed backing buffer and merged dirty intervals with full-upload threshold.
findings.acceptance: STD140 types/padding/arrays/matrices; sparse/dense hardware crossover.
findings.developmentStatus: Mock-driver call counts only; no implementation gain claimed.

findings.title: Opt-in dirty transform propagation
findings.observation: Static default10001-node tree recomposes10001 locals and multiplies10000 worlds; existing manual flags avoid this.
findings.proposedChange: Optional tracked transform/subtree contract preserving default mutable APIs.
findings.acceptance: Direct mutations, reparenting, animation/cameras, dirty fractions and update overhead.
findings.developmentStatus: Existing flags work; new automatic contract remains proposal.

findings.title: Explicit multipass preparation reuse
findings.observation: render() prepares matrices/lists/lights per call; no runtime gain measured.
findings.proposedChange: Explicit prepare/submit transaction with caller-declared immutable state scope.
findings.acceptance: Callbacks, nested rendering and camera/material/light/clipping invalidation.
findings.developmentStatus: Proposal; no automatic stale frame cache.

findings.title: Reuse useful render-list ordering
findings.observation: Items are already pooled; active membership and sorts rebuilt.
findings.proposedChange: Evaluate persistent ranks/unchanged-order checks against existing nearly-sorted sort.
findings.acceptance: Transparency correctness, insertion/removal, camera changes and custom callbacks.
findings.developmentStatus: Unmeasured; no allocation-every-frame claim.

findings.title: Scoped external GL state invalidation
findings.observation: Full reset clears and resets broad GL domains by design.
findings.proposedChange: Optional explicit invalidation domains with safe full-reset default.
findings.acceptance: Foreign GL mutations, pixel storage, targets, reversed depth and nesting.
findings.developmentStatus: Unmeasured API proposal.

findings.title: Separate shader errors from optional success logs
findings.observation: First use collects logs and link status when checks enabled; compileAsync already exists.
findings.proposedChange: Diagnostic policy retaining errors while deferring optional successful warning logs.
findings.acceptance: Compile/link failure diagnostics and callbacks; real driver stall measurements.
findings.developmentStatus: Unmeasured; do not globally disable checks.

findings.title: Bounded async pixel readback pools
findings.observation: Async API allocates/deletes a PBO per request; no hardware timing gain measured.
findings.proposedChange: Bounded size-class idle pool and in-flight budget with disposal/error handling.
findings.acceptance: Repeated small/large reads, idle bytes, context loss and pixel-pack/framebuffer state.
findings.developmentStatus: Unmeasured; asynchronous readback already present.

findings.title: Reduce unchanged WebGPU bundle refresh work
findings.observation: Bundles and render-object/pipeline/binding caches exist; cached bundle still refreshes render objects.
findings.proposedChange: Evaluate group epoch with explicit invalidation for static groups.
findings.acceptance: Node/material/geometry mutations, memory and CPU/GPU-separated benchmarks.
findings.developmentStatus: Source-only; new baseline GPU runs do not validate this optimization.

findings.title: Optional upload/cause/pass performance tracing
findings.observation: WebGL info lacks complete upload byte/cause trace; WebGPU already has detailed byte estimates.
findings.proposedChange: Low-disabled-cost WebGL and cause/pass counters; extend common info only for missing fields.
findings.acceptance: Disabled overhead, cross-pass attribution, allocation/range/call vs GPU timing distinction.
findings.developmentStatus: WebGPU byte counters confirmed at runtime; avoid duplicating them.

findings.title: FileLoader shares incompatible requests
findings.observation: Cache off: same URL with different headers deduplicates to one response; different response types also share decoded result.
findings.proposedChange: Request/response-compatible sharing and cache identity; independent consumer cancellation.
findings.acceptance: Equivalent dedup plus isolated header/credential/type/MIME, cache on/off, manager completion/error/abort.
findings.developmentStatus: Exact source identical at pinned dev.

findings.title: Shared BufferAttribute disposal breaks another geometry
findings.observation: After one geometry is disposed, another sharing its attribute falls from 78 to 0 colored pixels with GL error 1282; independent control preserves its hash.
findings.proposedChange: Define sharing ownership; retain live shared buffers and invalidate VAOs on buffer generation change.
findings.acceptance: Shared index/interleaved/instanced buffers, attribute replacement, final-owner release, multi-renderer/context.
findings.developmentStatus: Exact source identical at pinned dev.

findings.title: STLLoader preflight must precede allocation
findings.observation: An 84-byte malformed input attempts a 36 MB Float32 allocation; the guard prevents the actual allocation.
findings.proposedChange: Validate record counts/body before allocation and support explicit decoded budgets.
findings.acceptance: Short/huge/truncated headers, ASCII/binary solid ambiguity, colored records/trailing data.
findings.developmentStatus: Exact source identical at pinned dev.

findings.title: ImageBitmapLoader options race
findings.observation: Distinct URLs requested with none/flipY decode options both receive flipY; cache disabled.
findings.proposedChange: Snapshot decode options before asynchronous fetch.
findings.acceptance: Concurrent distinct URLs, mutable input objects, option override, failure/abort.
findings.developmentStatus: Exact source identical at pinned dev.

findings.title: WebGPU sparse updates fully repack padded attributes
findings.observation: One dirty component in 100,000 RGB vertices creates 400,000 CPU bytes and 100,000 views for four submitted GPU bytes.
findings.proposedChange: Retained staging and dirty-vertex repack with density threshold and storage-layout contract.
findings.acceptance: All padded types/item sizes, storage attributes, resizes, sparse/dense, peakbytes and timing.
findings.developmentStatus: Exact source identical at pinned dev.

findings.title: WebGPU ranges are submitted without merging
findings.observation: 256 identical ranges cause 256 queue writes / 4,096 submitted bytes for 16 unique bytes.
findings.proposedChange: Coalesce after padded/aligned interval mapping; bounded scratch and density threshold.
findings.acceptance: Duplicates/overlap/adjacency, Uint8/16 oddtails and nonzero offsets, byte equality and real timings.
findings.developmentStatus: Exact source identical at pinned dev.

findings.title: GLTFLoader repeats binary buffer copying
findings.observation: A valid 1,573,348-byte GLB causes 3,145,684 slice-copy bytes; parsed geometry counts are correct.
findings.proposedChange: Offset-aware source views and deliberate ownership/copy decisions.
findings.acceptance: Sparse/misaligned/interleaved/compressed/external buffers, plugins/transfers, retained source memory.
findings.developmentStatus: Exact source identical at pinned dev.

findings.title: Animation binding repeats scene name traversal
findings.observation: 1,000 tracks / 10,000 nodes cause 9,500,500 cold name reads; zero warm name reads and uncache controls pass.
findings.proposedChange: Ephemeral binding-pass name/UUID index preserving search precedence.
findings.acceptance: Duplicates/root/bones, mutable rename/reparent, groups, uncache/rebind, construction-memory crossover.
findings.developmentStatus: Exact source identical at pinned dev.

findings.title: Material subscriptions survive renderer disposal
findings.observation: Material dispose listeners grow 1, 2, 3 after renderer replacement; geometry/texture listeners remain zero; asset disposal clears all.
findings.proposedChange: Unsubscribe renderer-owned callbacks without creating long-lived strong material registry.
findings.acceptance: Dispose ordering/shared programs/context and heap snapshots; no measured byte leak claimed.
findings.developmentStatus: Renderer lifecycle locations unchanged; unrelated texture-copy diff only.

findings.title: GPU test helpers misclassify fallback backend
findings.observation: Firefox/WebKit each fail 11 compute tests on a WebGL fallback labeled webgpu; 11 other tests contain soft skips counted as passes.
findings.proposedChange: Validate backend identity; separate native/fallback/forced jobs and structured capability skips.
findings.acceptance: Native-required jobs fail without nativeadapter; preserve assertions and explicitly test promised fallback behavior.
findings.developmentStatus: Exact source identical at pinned dev.

findings.title: Example/manual lint baseline failures
findings.observation: Six of eight lint scopes are clean; examples have 11 errors and two warnings, manual has 15 errors.
findings.proposedChange: Fix examples and narrowly correct global environments; define CI coverage of intended surfaces.
findings.acceptance: Targeted lint plus affected interactive pages, no blanket useful-rule disable.
findings.developmentStatus: Project validation snapshot of r187; not re-run against full development tree.

findings.title: Development dependency advisories
findings.observation: Eight affected development package entries (two low, six moderate), from two advisory sources; zero high/critical.
findings.proposedChange: Compatible transitive/tool updates or input isolation; avoid forced incompatible downgrades.
findings.acceptance: Lock resolution/plugin compatibility, all lint and build configs; binary decoders separately inventoried.
findings.developmentStatus: Project validation snapshot of r187; not re-run against full development tree.
